title: 第一千六百二十五章 决战北冥二第一千六百二十四章 决战北冥一
content_zh:
刘长旭刚刚出手，便引来了人妖两族强者的关注。没办法，同时祭出二十五件玄天灵宝，这在当下的战场上那是绝无仅有的。
就连远方与鲲鹏妖帝激战的北冥仙帝见到这一幕，都颇为吃惊，因为拥有这么多玄天灵宝的太乙金仙实在太罕见了。
但是，最让人妖两族强者惊讶的还不仅于此。
在祭出十二柄红莲斩仙剑攻击那四位太乙妖仙的同时，刘长旭还施展出了“时空牢笼”仙术。
那四位太乙妖仙分别是两条太乙中期白龙、一头太乙中期雪熊、一头太乙后期雪鹿，个个实力不凡。
因此，即便见刘长旭祭出了十二柄红莲斩仙剑对付它们，这四位太乙妖仙也毫无畏惧，纷纷施展妖术神通进行拦截反击。
可是，不成想，一股无形的大道空间法则之力笼罩在它们身上，它们顿时感到自己犹如落入蛛网的蝇虫，被禁锢在虚空，无论它们如何挣扎，也无法摆脱。
而在这时，十二柄红莲斩仙剑裹挟着炙热无比的红莲业火，撕裂虚空轰杀而至。
那四位被时空牢笼禁锢在虚空的太乙妖仙心中大骇，赶紧催动防御神通进行抵挡。
那两头太乙中期白龙周身凝结出层层叠叠的冰甲水盾，将自己的肉身护在中间。
太乙中期雪熊的一双遮天熊掌，连连拍向红莲斩仙剑。
那头后期雪鹿则在周身凝聚出数道坚不可摧的冰壁，来阻挡红莲。
转瞬之间，十二柄红莲斩仙剑裹挟焚天烈焰接连落在四妖的防御屏障之上。
惊天动地的轰鸣声接连响起，刺目的赤红火光与极寒白光猛烈碰撞，耀眼强光瞬间笼罩整片空域。
冰火碰撞产生的狂暴冲击波四下横扫，原本就脆弱的虚空不堪重负，无数细碎漆黑的空间裂纹如同蛛网般疯狂蔓延。
白龙的冰甲水盾最先承受不住红莲业火灼烧，以及锋锐剑芒，轰然崩解。
雪熊的熊掌被剑锋劈出深可见骨的伤口，妖血飞溅而出。
雪鹿身周层层叠叠的冰壁更是一堵接一堵碎裂消融。
它们的防御虽然坚固，但是根本挡不住红莲斩仙剑的连环轰击，很快便被突破了防御。
一柄红莲斩仙剑裹挟滚滚红莲业火，划出一道赤红色长虹，狠狠劈砍在太乙中期雪鹿妖仙纤最脆弱的脖颈之上。

锋利无匹的剑刃轻易撕裂层层冰甲与护体光罩，寒光一闪，雪鹿硕大的头颅冲天飞起，滚烫妖血如泉涌般喷洒长空。
它残存的妖灵慌忙挣脱残破肉身，想要遁入虚空逃出生天，可它刚刚飞出，便被红莲业火彻底包裹。
红莲业火专克神魂，妖灵发出凄厉至极的哀嚎，转瞬便被灼烧殆尽，化作一缕淡淡青烟消散虚空，彻底断绝了复生的可能。
另一边，两头太乙中期白龙妖仙也好不到哪里去。层层冰盾早已在连环剑击下支离破碎，数柄红莲斩仙剑纵横穿梭，凌厉剑光直接将两条白龙修长的龙躯从中斩断，断口处烈焰灼烧龙筋龙髓，肉身当场崩碎。
所幸二龙根基深厚，反应极快，危急关头拼尽全力掩护妖灵脱身，最终，那两道淡青色妖灵顺利冲破红莲业火的阻拦，仓皇向着远方深海逃窜，总算保住复生的机会。
四妖之中下场最为凄惨的，当属那头肉身强横的太乙中期雪熊。
三道赤色剑光同时锁定它庞大身躯，三柄红莲斩仙剑轮番劈砍，熊妖厚重的皮甲在红莲斩仙剑面前根本不够看，粗壮四肢接连斩断，胸口妖血狂涌。它好不容易从残破躯体中挣脱出来的淡金色妖灵，还没来得及逃脱，便被翻涌而来的红莲业火死死裹住，不停的灼烧，最后化为一缕青烟彻底消散在天地间。
不到一炷香的时间，四名太乙妖仙全部陨落，仅有两妖的妖灵得以逃脱，如此战绩，令周围所有人大为惊骇。
十二柄红莲斩仙剑斩杀四妖后，赤光流转，乖乖回旋飞回刘长旭身侧环绕。
而刘长旭在一举斩杀四名太乙妖仙后，没有乘胜追击，反倒满脸警惕地扫视海面之上无边无际的兽潮。
他心中清楚，方才他一举斩杀四位太乙妖仙的表现太过惹眼，势必会引得妖族高层震怒，很快便会有更强的妖仙前来针对自己。
果不其然，妖族一众强者眼见自己这边四名太乙妖仙被刘长旭斩杀，大为恼怒。
一名大罗初期雪鹿按捺不住，当即踏空而来。
这头大罗雪鹿，身躯较之方才殒命的太乙雪鹿庞大数倍，冰之大道法则萦绕周身，恐怖的威压浩荡四方。它每踏一步，寒气便肆意蔓延，行经之处转瞬冰封千里，化作一片死寂的冰寒世界。
刘长旭眼见大罗期雪鹿即将到来，没有任何犹豫，当即将在大阵外疯狂毁灭兽潮的十二颗如意星辰珠收回到大阵之内。
他心中透亮，纵然自己手握二十五件玄天灵宝，底蕴远超同阶太乙金仙，可太乙与大罗之间隔着一道难以逾越的大道鸿沟，单凭这些灵宝，绝无可能正面击溃眼前这头掌控冰之大道的大罗雪鹿。
心念思绪间，那头大罗雪鹿已然出现在刘长旭镇守的大阵之前，没半句多余废话，直接掀起狂风暴雨般的猛烈攻势。
万千丈寒冰巨浪自海面拔地而起，裹挟无数锋利冰刃，朝着护岛大阵狠狠碾压而来。
刘长旭望着对方眼底翻涌的刻骨杀意，心中瞬间理清前因后果。方才被他斩去头颅、连妖灵都焚作青烟的那头太乙雪鹿，必然是这头大罗雪鹿的亲嗣。
难怪妖族众多大罗妖仙之中，唯有它第一时间主动冲上来针对自己，哪里是单纯奉命破阵，分明是痛失后辈，专程前来寻仇泄愤。

“原来是为子嗣报仇。”
刘长旭低声自语，神色愈发凝重。
这般背负丧亲之恨的大罗妖仙，出手绝不会留半分余地，攻势只会更加狂暴狠厉。
刘长旭当即运转起空间大道法则，准备硬抗这位大罗妖仙的攻势。
content_en:
Just as Liu Changxu made his move, he attracted the attention of powerful men from the human and demon tribes. There is no other way to sacrifice twenty-five Xuantian Spiritual Treasures at the same time, which is unique on the current battlefield.
Even Immortal Emperor Beiming, who was fighting fiercely with Demon Emperor Kunpeng in the distance, was quite surprised when he saw this scene, because it was so rare for Taiyi Golden Immortal to possess so many Xuantian spiritual treasures.
However, what surprised the powerful men and monsters the most was not just that.
While using twelve red lotus swords to attack the four Taiyi Demon Immortals, Liu Changxu also used the "Time and Space Cage" magic.
The four Taiyi demon immortals are two mid-stage Taiyi white dragons, a mid-stage Taiyi snow bear, and a late-stage Taiyi snow deer. They are all of extraordinary strength.
Therefore, even when Liu Changxu used twelve red lotus swords to deal with them, the four Taiyi Demon Immortals showed no fear and used their magical powers to intercept and counterattack.
However, unexpectedly, an invisible power of the law of space enveloped them, and they suddenly felt like flies caught in a spider's web, imprisoned in the void. No matter how hard they struggled, they could not escape.
At this moment, the twelve red lotus swords carrying the extremely hot red lotus karma fire tore through the void and struck.
The four Taiyi Demon Immortals, who were imprisoned in the void by the cage of time and space, were horrified and quickly activated their defensive powers to resist.
The two middle-stage Taiyi white dragons condensed layers of ice armor and water shields around their bodies, protecting their physical bodies in the middle.
In the middle stage of Taiyi, Snow Bear's pair of sky-covering bear palms struck Honglian with the Immortal Sword in succession.
The late-stage snow deer condensed several indestructible ice walls around its body to block Honglian.
In the blink of an eye, twelve red lotus-killing immortal swords wrapped in the sky-burning flames landed on the defensive barrier of the four demons one after another.
Earth-shaking roars sounded one after another, and the dazzling red firelight collided violently with the extremely cold white light, and the dazzling bright light instantly enveloped the entire airspace.
The violent shock wave generated by the collision of ice and fire swept across, overwhelming the originally fragile void, and countless small, dark space cracks spread like spider webs.
The white dragon's ice armor and water shield was the first to be unable to withstand the burning of the red lotus fire and the sharp sword light, and collapsed suddenly.
The snow bear's paw was split open by the sword, causing a bone-deep wound, and demon blood spattered out.
The layers of ice walls surrounding the snow deer were breaking and melting one after another.
Although their defenses were strong, they could not stop the continuous bombardment of the Red Lotus Immortal Sword, and the defenses were quickly breached.
A Red Lotus Immortal Killing Sword wrapped around the billowing red lotus karma fire, drew a crimson rainbow, and slashed hard at the most vulnerable neck of the Snow Deer Demon Immortal in the middle stage of Taiyi.
The extremely sharp blade easily tore through the layers of ice armor and protective shields. With a flash of cold light, the snow deer's huge head flew into the sky, and hot demon blood sprayed into the sky like a spring.
Its remaining demon spirit hurriedly broke away from its broken body, trying to escape into the void, but as soon as it flew out, it was completely enveloped by the red lotus karma fire.
The red lotus karma fire specializes in conquering the soul, and the demon spirit let out a shrill wail, and was burned out in an instant, turning into a wisp of light blue smoke and dissipating into the void, completely cutting off the possibility of resurrection.
On the other side, the two mid-stage Taiyi White Dragon Demon Immortals were not much better. The layers of ice shields had already been shattered by the series of sword blows. Several red lotus swords were criss-crossing, and the sharp sword light directly cut off the slender bodies of the two white dragons. The flames at the break burned the dragon's tendons and marrow, and the flesh shattered on the spot.
Fortunately, the two dragons had deep foundations and reacted very quickly. They tried their best to protect the demon spirits from escaping at the critical moment. In the end, the two light blue demon spirits successfully broke through the obstruction of the red lotus karma fire and fled towards the distant deep sea in a hurry, finally saving the chance of resurrection.
Among the four monsters, the one who met the most miserable fate was undoubtedly the physically powerful Taiyi Mid-stage Snow Bear.
Three red sword lights locked on its huge body at the same time, and the three Red Lotus Immortal-Slaying Swords took turns slashing at it. The bear demon's thick leather armor was not enough to see in front of the Red Lotus Immortal-Slaying Sword., the thick limbs were cut off one after another, and the demon blood surged from the chest. The pale golden demon spirit finally broke free from its broken body. Before it could escape, it was tightly wrapped in the red lotus karma fire that surged in. It kept burning, and finally turned into a wisp of blue smoke and completely dissipated between the heaven and the earth.
In less than a stick of incense, all four Taiyi Demon Immortals perished, and only two demon spirits managed to escape. This achievement horrified everyone around them.
After killing four monsters with twelve red lotus swords, the red light circulated and flew back to Liu Changxu's side to surround him.
Liu Changxu killed four Taiyi Demon Queens in one fell swoop. Instead of pursuing the victory, he scanned the boundless tide of beasts above the sea with a vigilant face.
He knew in his heart that his performance of killing four Taiyi Demon Immortals in one fell swoop was so eye-catching that it would inevitably arouse the anger of the higher-ups of the Demon Clan, and a stronger Demon Immortal would soon come to target him.
Sure enough, the strong men of the demon clan were very angry when they saw the four Taiyi demon immortals on their side being killed by Liu Changxu.
A Snow Deer in the early stage of Daluo couldn't hold back and immediately came out of the air.
This big Luo Snow Deer was several times larger than the Taiyi Snow Deer that had just died. The Law of Ice Road lingered around him, and the terrifying pressure was overwhelming in all directions. Every time it takes a step, the cold air spreads wantonly, and the place it passes is instantly frozen for thousands of miles, turning into a dead and cold world.
When Liu Changxu saw that the Great Luo Stage Snow Deer was about to arrive, he did not hesitate at all. When the twelve Ruyi Star Beads that were about to crazily destroy the beast tide outside the formation were withdrawn into the formation.
His heart was clear. Even though he held twenty-five Xuantian Spiritual Treasures, his foundation far surpassed that of the Taiyi Golden Immortal of the same level, but there was an insurmountable avenue gap between Taiyi and Daluo. With these spiritual treasures alone, it was impossible to defeat the Daluo Snow Deer who controlled the Ice Avenue in front of him.
As he was thinking about it, the big Luo Snow Deer had already appeared in front of the large formation guarded by Liu Changxu. Without any unnecessary nonsense, he launched a fierce offensive like a violent storm.
Thousands of feet of ice waves rose up from the sea, carrying countless sharp ice blades and crushing them towards the island protection formation.
Liu Changxu looked at the murderous intent surging in the other person's eyes, and he instantly understood the cause and effect. The Taiyi Snow Deer whose head he had just beheaded and whose demon spirit was burned into smoke must be the direct heir of this Da Luo Snow Deer.
No wonder, among the many Da Luo demon immortals in the demon clan, it was the only one that immediately rushed forward to target him. Rather than simply being ordered to break the formation, it was clearly because he was deeply saddened by the loss of his descendants and came here specifically to seek revenge and vent his anger.
"It turned out to be revenge for the heir."
Liu Changxu whispered to himself, his expression becoming more solemn.
The Daluo Demon Immortal, who is burdened with the hatred of bereavement, will never leave any room for action, and his attacks will only become more violent and fierce.
Liu Changxu immediately activated the Law of Space Avenue, preparing to resist the offensive of the Great Luo Demon Immortal.
